Consider a resolution of the City Council of the City of Bedford, Texas, ordering a special election to be held on Saturday, August 7, 2021 for the purpose of electing a person to City Council, Place 4, with a term to expire May 2023; authorizing a contract for election services with Tarrant County; and establishing the dates and times for early voting for such election. | ITEM:

Election Day is 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Saturday, August 7, 2021. In order to avoid confusion, staff is recommending the main Election Day voting location in Bedford be the Bedford Public Library at 2424 Forest Ridge Drive. 
 
As in the past and per state law, staff recommends that this election be administered by the Tarrant County Election’s Administration. This has proven to be the most cost effective and efficient way to hold elections. The estimated cost for contracting with the County is $18,000; however, there are cost savings from the May 1, 2021 General Election that will help alleviate the fiscal impact. The savings are due to the fact the City Secretary’s Office always budgets as if the City were going to be solely responsible for the costs of its polling locations.
